newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania November jobless rate 6.1 pct vs 5.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania November jobless rate 6.1 pct vs 5.9 pct.

text.p: Romania's unemployment rate rose to 6.1 percent in November from 5.9 percent the previous month, the Labour Ministry said on Monday.
It said the slight increase in the jobless figure was a result of a change in Romania's workforce, put at 10.491 million, down from 11.235 million previously.
The number of unemployment benefit claimants was 644,620 in November, some 15,000 down from October.
NOTE -- The ministry said the number of job openings stands at 16,586. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
